The first public release of Steamed: host your Minecraft world through a Steam lobby and play with your Steam friends,
with no port forwarding and no third-party tunnels. Connections go through Steam's own peer-to-peer network, directly
when possible and relayed when not.

Install the jar for your loader (Fabric, NeoForge or Quilt) and keep Steam running. Everyone in a lobby needs Steamed
0.1.3 and the same Minecraft version.

### Hosting and joining

- Create a lobby from the pause menu, then invite friends from an in-game friend list (no Steam overlay needed)
- Invites show up as a toast and wait for you to accept them
- The Steam Lobby screen lists friends who are hosting right now, so you can join without an invite
- Lobbies are friends-only or invite-only, with a max players setting (2, 4, 8, 16 or 250). Lobbies above 8 work because
  Steamed lifts the integrated server's built-in 8-player cap while you host
- Hosts can kick players. Everyone is disconnected cleanly when the host closes the lobby

### Security

- Every joiner proves who they are with a Steam auth ticket before any traffic reaches your world
- A world hosted through Steam is only opened on loopback, not to your LAN
- If e4mc or e4all is installed, Steamed warns that it may also have opened your world to the internet

### Extras

- Simple Voice Chat and Plasmo Voice are tunnelled through Steam automatically
- BlueMap and squaremap web maps reach joiners through Steam, with a chat link to open them
- Players who joined through Steam get an orange diamond before their name tag and in the Tab list, and their
  join/leave lines in chat are orange too
- Player heads for Steam friends in the lobby and invite screens

### Quality of life

- Translated into English, Polish, German, Ukrainian and Russian
- Steam not running is handled: a toast at startup, and a retry button in the lobby screen once you've started Steam.
  If Steam quits mid-game, you leave the lobby cleanly and are told why
- Lobbies record Minecraft's version, so hosts on a different version are greyed out instead of failing mid-connect

### Good to know

- Steamed uses Spacewar (Steam app ID 480) for now, so friends see you as "playing Spacewar"
- Quilt support is experimental
- The Fabric and Quilt jars need Fabric API and Fabric Language Kotlin. NeoForge needs nothing else
